articles.title: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
articles.description:
At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports
Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a new report.
More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, according to HIV Justice Network, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.
 Continue reading...

articles.summary: セネガルで同性愛を犯罪とする法律が強化され、LGBTQ+の人々に対する取り締まりが激化。320人以上が逮捕され、強制HIV検査も行われている。

articles.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story
articles.description:
Article in Atlantic claims The Blue Fighter was artificially generated, days after it won Caine prize for African writers
The Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using AI to write a prize-winning short story after an article in the Atlantic said software had flagged it as almost completely AI-generated.
Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter was announced as the winner of the prestigious Caine prize for African writers on 6 October. Five days later, The Atlantic published an article by the author and journalist Vauhini Vara titled: “Yet Another Literary prize winner Seems to Be AI.”
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns
articles.description:
Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr
Guinea-Bissau has not approved the controversial hepatitis B study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.
The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Controversial vaccine trial touted by RFK Jr gets go-ahead in Guinea-Bissau
articles.description:
Recommended dose of hepatitis B vaccine will be withheld from thousands of newborns by Danish researchers
A controversial research trial that will withhold hepatitis B vaccines from some African newborns was given approval to move forward this week.
It is a central part of the vaccine vision for Robert F Kennedy Jr, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime vaccine opponent.
This article was amended on 13 October 2026. A previous version said CIDRAP first reported news that the research trial was approved by the Denmark ethics committee. Rolling Stone had actually reported the news first.
 Continue reading...

Committee recognises work of South African who chaired UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza

The Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza.
The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”.

Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows.
But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump.

articles.title: Brazil’s Lula says he now backs lowering age of criminal responsibility to 16
articles.description:
Lula reverses position on age of responsibility for ‘heinous’ crimes in what many see as a desperate electoral gambit
Brazil’s president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has announced that he now supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility for “heinous” crimes from 18 to 16, reversing a longstanding policy in what is widely seen as a desperate electoral gambit.
The U-turn, which Lula announced during a Thursday night interview with TV Globo, comes with the presidential runoff in just over a week. The incumbent faces an uphill battle to overturn the first-round victory of his opponent, the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who remains slightly ahead at the polls.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: ‘Opening the lid of a horrible secret’: Jamaicans confront enslavement with taboo-busting stories on screen
articles.description:
As violent spirits are unleashed in Sky’s Possession, observers see confident creatives reclaiming the island’s narratives in a form of ‘cultural reparation’   
A woman opens a 300‑year‑old box, unleashing a violent spirit – it is the spirit of colonialism and oppression roaring back to life. It is a pivotal scene in Sky’s supernatural series Possession and symbolises a wider shift in Jamaica’s film industry, where directors are increasingly using the landscape to tell Jamaican stories – including those that confront enslavement, trauma and historical memory.
The series is about a biracial British lawyer who travels to Jamaica to investigate a multimillion-pound inheritance dispute, only to uncover a dark, vengeful spirit tied to the plantation’s brutal colonial past.
 Continue reading...

Maduro, shackled at the ankles, was brought to court to face the new charges accusing the couple of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of victims, including three Americans.

articles.description: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

articles.title: How authoritarian states are building an international market for digital surveillance
articles.description: Digital authoritarianism is not developing in isolation, but through the international exchange of technologies, standards, and practices.
articles.titleJa: 権威主義国家がいかにしてデジタル監視の国際市場を構築しているか
articles.summary: 権威主義国家が技術、基準、慣行の国際的な交換を通じてデジタル監視市場を構築。国際的な脅威となっている。

articles.title: How Ecuador is fighting to keep industrial trans fats off the food shelf
articles.description: As health advocates push for tighter controls, Ecuador confronts the gap between regulating trans fats and enforcing those rules.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルはいかにして工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除しようとしているか
articles.summary: エクアドルが工業用トランス脂肪酸の規制と実施の間の隔たりに直面。健康擁護者がより厳格な管理を求めている。

articles.title: Trump’s ‘Agreements on Reciprocal Trade’ (ARTs) threaten equitable access to the internet in Global South
articles.description: The controversial reciprocal trade agreements (ARTs) gives the U.S. a great deal of power, which could adversely affect digital connectivity, increase digital divides, and reduce economic growth in signatory countries.
articles.titleJa: トランプの「互恵貿易協定」（ARTs）がグローバルサウスにおけるインターネットの公平なアクセスを脅かす
articles.summary: トランプの互恵貿易協定がグローバルサウスのデジタル接続と経済成長に悪影響を与え、デジタル格差を拡大する恐れがある。

articles.title: El Niño speeds climate crisis and tests Latin America’s food security
articles.description: From droughts to floods and fires, El Niño is exposing vulnerabilities in Latin America’s food systems by putting farmers, food supplies and household budgets under growing pressure across the region.
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョ現象が気候危機を加速させ、ラテンアメリカの食料安全保障を試す
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象がラテンアメリカの食料システムを脆弱にし、農民、食料供給、家計予算に大きな圧力をかけ、地域全体の食料安全保障が危機に瀕している。

articles.title: Young people are bridging the climate divide for Oceania and the Caribbean
articles.description: “The lack of strong and consistent climate policy means that every year, families lose loved ones, homes, and entire livelihoods because of climate-related disasters.”
articles.titleJa: 若者たちがオセアニアとカリブ海の気候格差を埋める
articles.summary: 気候政策の欠如により、オセアニアとカリブ海では毎年多くの人々が気候関連災害で生活を失っている。若者たちがこの格差を埋めるべく活動。

articles.title: In Brazil’s capital, residents grow their own heat-fighting solutions
articles.description: Life in the favelas surrounding Brazil’s capital brings the health risks of extreme heat — a symptom of the global inequities of green space access
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの首都で住民が猛暑対策を独自に育てる
articles.summary: ブラジルの首都周辺のファベーラでは、猛暑が健康リスクをもたらし、緑地アクセスにおける世界的な不平等を露呈。住民は独自に対策を講じている。

articles.title: Equating protest with terrorism: A narrative against dissent
articles.description: In this month's edition, we dive deep into a narrative used by leaders in the United States and other countries to delegitimize protests.
articles.titleJa: 抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視する：異議申し立てに反対する言説
articles.summary: 米国など複数の国の指導者が抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視する言説を用いており、異議申し立てを不当なものとして扱っている実態を深く掘り下げる。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions
articles.description: Too often, resources and meaning flow outward from the community that created them and enrich outsiders — often the same groups that have been oppressing them for centuries.
articles.titleJa: 先住民族の文化と伝統の商品化
articles.summary: 先住民族の文化と伝統が商品化され、その資源や意味が外部の利益となり、長年彼らを抑圧してきた勢力を潤すという問題に焦点を当てる。

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest
articles.description: The youth-led movement had called for a Delhi protest after mass detentions last week and the jailing of two leaders.
articles.titleJa: インドの「ゴキブリ党」創設者、抗議活動前に拘束
articles.summary: インドで若者主導の「ゴキブリ党」創設者が、抗議活動前に拘束された。先週の大量拘束や指導者2名の投獄を受け、デリーでの抗議が呼びかけられていた。

articles.title: 'Onion cartel' in Philippines fined $28m for price shock
articles.description: Onions were worth more than the daily minimum wage at the height of the price surge in 2022.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンの「タマネギカルテル」に2800万ドルの罰金、価格高騰で
articles.summary: フィリピンでタマネギ価格を不当に吊り上げた「タマネギカルテル」に対し、2800万ドルの罰金が科された。2022年の価格高騰時には、タマネギの値段が日最低賃金を超えるほどだった。

articles.title: At the scene of a school roof collapse in Pakistan
articles.description: At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed according to hospital officials, and more than a dozen were injured.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンでの学校屋根崩落現場から
articles.summary: パキスタンの学校で屋根が崩落し、病院関係者によると少なくとも生徒33人と教師1人が死亡、十数人以上が負傷した。

articles.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
articles.description: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンで学校の屋根崩落、生徒33人と教師が死亡
articles.summary: パキスタンで学校の屋根が崩落し、警察によると生徒33人と教師1人が死亡した。屋根が3つの教室を突き破り、子供たちががれきの下敷きになった。

articles.title: Watch: Pupils heard 'cracking' sound  moments before Pakistan school roof collapse
articles.description: Our Urdu correspondent reports from the scene in Peshawar, north-west Pakistan, where emergency services have been responding to the incident.
articles.titleJa: 動画：パキスタンの学校屋根崩落直前、生徒たちは「亀裂音」を聞いていた
articles.summary: パキスタン北西部のペシャワールで発生した学校の屋根崩落事故について、緊急サービスが対応する中、生徒たちは崩落直前に「亀裂音」を聞いていたと報じられている。

articles.title: An Australian band’s ‘unreal’ journey to break a gig world record
articles.description: The dream rock band called Fathom travelled roughly 700km across Australia by car, helicopter and plane to play nine shows in 12 hours.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアのバンド、ギグの世界記録更新へ「非現実的な」挑戦
articles.summary: オーストラリアのドリームロックバンド「ファゾム」が、車、ヘリコプター、飛行機で約700kmを移動し、12時間で9回のギグを行うという世界記録に挑戦した。

articles.title: Actor Imran Khan ordered to leave India after participating in protest
articles.description: The Bollywood actor had been detained and released while participating in a protest in Mumbai on 10 October.
articles.titleJa: 抗議活動に参加した俳優イムラン・カーン、インドからの出国を命じられる
articles.summary: ボリウッド俳優のイムラン・カーンが、10月10日にムンバイの抗議活動に参加した後に拘束・釈放されたが、インドからの出国を命じられた。

articles.title: Indian woman and boyfriend get death sentence in 'blue drum' murder case
articles.description: The body was recovered from a large blue plastic storage container - locally called a drum.
articles.titleJa: インド人女性と恋人、「青いドラム缶」殺人事件で死刑判決
articles.summary: インドで「青いドラム缶」殺人事件の裁判が行われ、インド人女性とその恋人に死刑判決が下された。遺体は、現地でドラム缶と呼ばれる大型の青いプラスチック製収納容器から発見された。

articles.title: Desperate to clear toxic haze, Indonesia douses its skies with dry ice
articles.description: Authorities in South East Asia have turned to weather modification as fires blanket the region in smog.
articles.titleJa: 有毒な煙害を解消するため、インドネシアが空にドライアイスを散布
articles.summary: 有毒な煙害を解消しようと、インドネシア当局は火災が地域を覆う中で気象改変に着手し、空にドライアイスを散布している。

articles.title: Australian woman charged with lacing colleague's curry with snail poison
articles.description: The alleged victim, who was in a relationship with the woman, had spotted bright green pellets in the meal.
articles.titleJa: 同僚のカレーにカタツムリ毒を混入させたとしてオーストラリア人女性を起訴
articles.summary: オーストラリアで、同僚のカレーにカタツムリ毒を混入させたとして女性が起訴された。被害者は女性と関係があり、食事中に鮮やかな緑色の粒を発見したという。

articles.title: WTO and multilateral partners review progress on supply chain finance initiative
articles.description: Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala joined leaders of multilateral development banks and other international organizations at a high-level roundtable held on the sidelines of the 2026 World Bank – International Monetary Fund (IMF) Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, on 16 October to review progress in expanding supply chain finance in developing economies and to discuss priorities for the next phase of cooperation.
articles.titleJa: WTOと多国間パートナーがサプライチェーン金融イニシアチブの進捗状況をレビュー
articles.summary: WTOと多国間パートナーがタイで開催された会議で、途上国のサプライチェーン金融拡大の進捗状況をレビューし、次期協力の優先事項を議論した。

articles.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
articles.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
articles.summary: 東ティモールが政府調達協定（GPA）加盟に必要な主要文書を提出し、交渉が開始された。委員会は規制動向も検討した。

articles.title: Report underlines value of WTO committee in helping resolve market access trade concerns
articles.description: A first-ever report by the WTO Secretariat on the resolution of trade concerns related to market access highlights the effectiveness of the organization's committee work in helping members settle their differences without resorting to dispute settlement. The report was presented at a 12-13 October meeting of the WTO's Committee on Market Access (CMA). The committee also reviewed a record 36 trade concerns raised by members at its meeting, eight of which were raised for the first time.
articles.titleJa: WTO委員会の市場アクセス貿易懸念解決における価値を報告書が強調
articles.summary: WTO事務局の報告書は、市場アクセス貿易懸念の解決における委員会の有効性を強調。委員会は記録的な36件の貿易懸念を検討した。

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
articles.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカルが一部菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート菓子の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: AI boom and trade resilience to Middle East crisis lift outlook, but gains to be uneven
articles.description: Global trade proved more resilient than expected in the first half of 2026 despite the disruption caused by the Middle East conflict, as supply chains adapted and strong investment in artificial intelligence provided a powerful boost to goods trade. However, the resilience was not uniform, with services trade and some regions more exposed to the effects of the conflict. WTO economists have therefore raised the forecast for merchandise trade growth in 2026 while lowering the outlook for services trade.
articles.titleJa: AIブームと中東危機に対する貿易の回復力が経済見通しを押し上げるが、利益は不均一に
articles.summary: 中東紛争とAI投資により世界の貿易見通しは改善。しかし、サービス貿易や一部地域で影響が不均一なため、WTOは商品貿易予測を上方修正。

articles.title: Services bodies spotlight Public Forum, remittance costs and development issues
articles.description: At meetings held from 7 to 9 October, the WTO Council for Trade in Services and the Committee on Trade in Financial Services commended the fruitful discussions on services trade at the 2026 Public Forum, continued discussions on transparency of measures regarding recognition of foreign service suppliers' qualifications, and exchanged views on how to reinvigorate the Council's work. Members also addressed how to facilitate digital payment systems and reduce the cost of remittances, help least-developed countries (LDCs) strengthen their participation in services trade, and various trade concerns.
articles.titleJa: サービス機関が公開フォーラム、送金コスト、開発問題に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: サービス機関が公開フォーラムの議論を称賛し、送金コスト削減やLDCのサービス貿易参加促進、デジタル決済システムなどについて議論した。

articles.title: Rules of Origin Committee reviews LDC preferences, shares best practices
articles.description: The WTO Committee on Rules of Origin (CRO) met on 7-8 October to review developments in preferential rules of origin for least-developed countries (LDCs), hear updates from preference-granting members, and exchange experiences on origin administration and trade facilitation. Members also examined notifications on non-preferential rules of origin, discussed digital tools that can improve transparency and compliance with origin requirements, and considered draft annual reports on the Committee's work.
articles.titleJa: 原産地規則委員会が後発開発途上国優遇をレビュー、ベストプラクティスを共有
articles.summary: WTO原産地規則委員会は、LDCの優遇措置の進捗をレビューし、原産地管理と貿易円滑化に関する経験を共有。デジタルツールの活用も議論した。

articles.title: General Council addresses WTO reform, ministerial follow-ups, ongoing negotiations
articles.description: WTO members meeting at the General Council on 5-6 October addressed issues related to the ongoing discussions on WTO reform, follow-up to outcomes of past ministerial conferences, and the state of ongoing negotiations on various topics. Members also discussed issues related to the Agreement on Electronic Commerce, emerging agricultural trade issues, and optimizing the outcome of future ministerial conferences, among other issues.
articles.titleJa: 一般理事会がWTO改革、閣僚会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉を検討
articles.summary: WTO一般理事会は、組織改革、閣僚会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉、電子商取引や農業貿易問題など、幅広い議題を議論した。

articles.title: Co-sponsors of sustainability initiative advance work plan towards MC15
articles.description: At a meeting on 2 October, co-sponsors of the Trade and Environmental Sustainability Structured Discussions (TESSD) discussed a work plan for 2026-27 in preparation for the 15th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC15). They identified priorities, working methods and potential deliverables for each work area, and expressed broad support for a transition towards more flexible and outcome-oriented work.
articles.titleJa: 持続可能性イニシアチブの共同提案者がMC15に向けた作業計画を進める
articles.summary: 貿易と環境持続可能性に関する構造的議論（TESSD）の共同提案者が、第15回WTO閣僚会議に向けた2026-27年の作業計画を議論した。

articles.title: WTO MSME Group explores IP's role in trade, hears success stories and updates
articles.description: The Informal Working Group on Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs) met on 2 October, with a focus on the practical role of intellectual property (IP) in helping small businesses innovate, grow and reach international markets. The meeting included an information session on IP tools and thematic presentations from members, international organizations and stakeholders. Several members reported on MSME initiatives in formal WTO committees.
articles.titleJa: WTO MSMEグループが貿易におけるIPの役割を探る、成功事例と更新情報を聞く
articles.summary: WTOのMSME非公式作業部会が、中小企業の国際市場進出における知的財産（IP）の役割に焦点を当て、成功事例や最新情報を共有した。
